evidence.section: 3. Features of structure and crystallization behavior of bulk glassy alloys
evidence.quote: For instance, the Zr65Al7.5Ni10Cu17.5 glassy alloy has the sequent phase transition of the glass transition, followed by a large supercooled liquid region and then a single exothermic peak due to a simultaneous precipitation of Zr2Ni, Zr2Cu, Zr2Al3 and ZrNi phases [29].
